name: The Silver Candle (Ngân Chúc Đăng)
lore: A tall candlestick of silver with a white pine-wax candle that is never allowed to burn down, after the line of Đỗ Mục's that the head is named for: a silver candle, autumn light, a cold painted screen. Every Dipper talisman the Pivot has bought since 912 was painted by its light.
build_use: The head's lamp: talisman damage and speed, and a second stroke.

name: Dipper Talisman Seal (Bắc Đẩu Phù Ấn)
lore: The seal stamped in the corner of every talisman the Hall sells, seven dots and a handle cut in boxwood. Whoever holds it is the Hall's chief painter. Kỷ Ngân Chúc gave it to Lạc Tố Bình in 1170.
build_use: The chief painter's seal: faster talismans.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Gourd of Rainfast Ink (Bất Tẩy Mặc Hồ)
lore: The Hall's rain-fast ink, Mặc Yên soot made fast by the Hall's own writ, kept in a black gourd; once dry, it does not run in rain or blood.
build_use: Marks that last: Water behind the Wood talismans.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)
